name: Beach sports on My Khe
kicker: Surf, paddle, and basket boats on the sand
summary: Rent a surfboard, a kayak, or a jet ski, go parasailing, or try a round basket boat on My Khe, where the long city beach doubles as a water-sports ground. A surf lesson takes about two hours, with stand-up paddle as well. Agree the price on the sand before you go out.
getThere: My Khe, on Vo Nguyen Giap. Confirm the surf-school meeting point.
heroCaption: The sports huts on the sand

notice.title: Confirm where the surf school meets
notice.body: Da Nang Surf School works from Vo Nguyen Giap, inside Temple Danang, and also gives 119 Tran Phu as an address. Confirm the meeting point before you set out.

body: The swim is only the start of My Khe. The sand is also for surfboards, skurfing, jet skis, sailing, parasailing, snorkeling and diving, kayaks, and basket boats, the round craft locals race off the beach.
For a lesson, Da Nang Surf School works from Vo Nguyen Giap, inside Temple Danang, from 08:00 to 17:00. A lesson takes about two hours, and stand-up paddle is on offer too.
The basket boats sit pulled up on the sand. Ask the price for a boat, a board, or a jet ski before you go out.

figures.caption: Basket boats pulled up on the sand
figures.alt: Round basket boats lined up on a Da Nang beach

gettingThere: Go to My Khe. The surf school is on Vo Nguyen Giap, inside Temple Danang. From the river, take a Grab across the Han.

legs.heading: From a My Khe hotel
legs.body: Walk to Vo Nguyen Giap and confirm the meeting point.

hours: Surf school: 08:00–17:00 (city portal, 2017); every day (English portal page, 2016). Lesson about two hours; the 2016 page also lists a one-hour visit. Address on the 2016 page: 119 Tran Phu, with lessons on Vo Nguyen Giap.
admissionNote: Check on arrival. Ignore the one-dollar figure on the 2016 English page.
